stations.title: Customer
stations.say: How often to water my monstera?

stations.title: Odile and Ravi
stations.text: Answer the same questions every week.

stations.title: Moss
stations.note: It only knows what it is sent.

captions: At Fernhollow, a customer asks how often to water a monstera.
Moss cannot hear the question yet, so Odile or Ravi answers by hand.
You write the call to the model, in three tasks.
Now Moss answers, and you can tell if the reply came back whole.
One question in, one answer out. Moss can talk.
